title: Page 5
content_zh:
回到灶房，如意将摘来的茄子跟青葱洗净搁在一旁，然后
见她开始打蛋揉面，段柯古忍不住问：“这些面粉给了我，你明天的肉饼怎么办？”
“早备齐了。”她下颚朝邻旁菜橱子一点。
“跟你打个商量。”他走回来看着她问：“我还会在扬州待上几天，就劳你辛苦些，多帮我准备一份吃食，饭钱由你订，意下如何？”
她想了会儿，眼一斜，糗他。“好个一石二鸟之计。”
“就知道瞒不过你。”他抚掌低笑。
他所以开出这条件，一来是想多给她一点现钱收入，二来呢，是看在他或许可以伺机说动她跟她娘，跟他一块到江州去。当然，里边最要紧的，还是满足他的口腹之欲。
她边想边揉面团，直到面团变得平滑软韧，她这才抬头回话：“我得先问过我娘。”
“全依你。”他边说边脱去身上华贵的外袍凑到她身边。“我来吧？”
“您会？”她一脸惊讶。
“不会。”他答得爽快。“只是面是我要吃的，我怎么好意思傻站在旁边，看你忙得汗流挟背。”
她忍不住多看了他几眼，这个人与她遇过知道的官爷们，完全不一样。
“我知道你现在想什么。”他屈手卷高衣袖。“一定是觉得我很怪，对吧？”
这话是他自个儿说的。如意不置可否地拿起面棍，压在面团上用力平。“瞧清楚了，您就照这方式使劲。”
段柯古接手。“要多久？”
“到面团变平，之后还得迭起再，一共得弄上八回。”
他吓了一跳。“不过是碗面，也得费这么多功夫？”
她娇媚一睨。“如果您不介意面吃起来木渣渣的，省个一半手续也成。”
“那算了。”既然事关尝起来的滋味，他还是乖乖照办好了。
她在一旁见他得上手，遂也安心地洗刷她的蒸笼去。

“不对啊！”大汗淋漓之余他突然想起。“你一个千金小姐，哪里学来这等手艺？”
“谁说千金小姐就不能下厨做菜？”她倒扣蒸笼，抹干手走了过来。“我从小见我爹待灶房里，久了我自然知道，想多看他几眼让他多跟我说几句话，我就得想办法多习点手艺。”
看着她的眉眼忽然变得温柔，还真是难为她一番孝心。
“对了，”他想起来。“你娘下午不是提了什么菜谱的事……”
他话还没说完，她突然捂住他嘴。“这事不许再提。”
“什么？”望着她突然凑近的娇容，他表情一愣。
就在这时，曲母探头进来。
“段公子？”她惊讶地瞧着自个儿女儿与段柯古。“怎么？你们？”才多久时间，这两个人竟变得这么熟络了？
如意赶忙移开手，脸颊微红。“我瞧他脸上沾了面粉，才帮他擦掉——”她边说边走来她娘身边，回头对着段柯古使眼色。
“嗳。”虽然一头雾水，但段柯古仍旧认了她说词。“大娘还没歇息？”
“早歇下了。”曲母有趣地瞧着他俩。早些她没细看，这会儿再见，发觉他俩站一块还真是郎才女貌，适配得很。“是突然听见有人说话，才来看看怎么回事。我说段公子，怎么这么晚了您还在这儿？”
“他在‘小莲庄’受了气。”怕他说出不该说的话，如意连忙解释：“浪费了时间又吃不到好东西，才过来咱们这儿碰碰运气。”
“哎呀，这可要好好招待才行。”曲母转头看着女儿责备。“你怎么可以让客人自小儿下厨弄东西！”
段柯古哪可能坐视如意被怪罪，赶紧帮腔。“是我硬缠着要如意姑娘教我。还有，不亲手做，我还不知道大娘跟如意姑娘，平常多辛苦。”
“既然是您自个儿想试，大娘就无话可说了。那我先回房去，你们俩忙完就早点休息。”最后这句话曲母是看着女儿说。
如意点点头，她娘是要她当心附近人家的闲言闲语；毕竟她还是个未出阁的闺女。
待曲母进了房，段柯古才压低声音问：“刚为什么不许我提那件事？”
“陆明。”她不再避讳，反正一般人不清楚的事儿，他早都知道了。“他一直逼着要我们给他菜谱，我们是诓他我爹没交代，但他不信。”
“很珍贵？”
她探头戳戳桌上面团，然后抬头。“自我祖父那代一路秘传，您说呢？”

原来是传家之宝，难怪如此保密。“我知道了，以后我不会再提。”
见他爽快答应，如意忍不住抬头多看了他一会儿。“您……很特别。”
他打趣问：“因为我肯动手面？”
这只是其一。如意转个身开始切起茄子。刚摘下洗过的茄子圆润饱满，紫色泛光的表面，犹能映出她娟秀的侧脸。
“您没什么官架子，还有，您好像没什么野心。”
一般人听闻她们藏了本不外传的珍贵菜谱，哪个不心生凯觎，想取来一窥究竟。但他只是笑一笑，就接受了她的说法。
“这点你错了。”他忘了手上满是面粉，还拿手擦额角。“我所以不过问，因为我的目标是你，只要能把你拐回去，我要吃什么没有？”
他笑得灿烂，浑然不觉他脸白了一块的模样多逗趣。如意忍俊不禁笑出声来。
“怎么了？我脸上有什么……”他还傻傻拿手摸脸，猛一看才知怎么回事。“哎呦！”
“我来吧！”不忍见他越擦越脏，如意自怀里掏出手绢，要他脸略往下倾好让她帮忙。
他近距离看着她脂粉未施的眉眼，手绢一拂一拂，隐约可以嗅到一股淡雅的香味。那瞬间，他终于明了《诗经》里（硕人）夸赞的美人，不全是出自想象。
因为他面前正有这么一名佳人。
他按住她手低吟：“手如柔荑，肤若凝脂，领如蝤蚊，齿如瓠犀，螓首娥眉，巧笑请兮，美目盼兮。”
如意熟读经书，怎不明白他是藉诗夸赞她长得漂亮。她脸一红，忙将手绢塞他手里。“您自个儿擦，我去煮水准备下面。”
望着她佯忙的身影，他呆呆地将手绢拿近擦了擦，一嗅到上头淡淡香气，他心头，不禁泛起一股奇异的骚乱。
用过晚膳，段柯古独自走回落脚的“如往来”客栈。此时他仍满嘴是紫腴茄子与小磨香油的香气。在京上，什么好吃东西他没尝过，但就不晓得只是一盘混了茄子与青葱的素卤面，竟会如此清香宜人，味醇适口。
还有这条手绢——就着窗外射进的月光，他反复审视被他污了一角的手绢。或许是害羞，如意把手绢丢给他之后便没再提起，而他也顺水推舟带了回来。
帕上一角绣上一柄翠如意，瞧那绣工，就知这绢该是她从“小莲庄”带出来的，意义非凡，他理当差人洗干净再将它送回。可不知怎么搞的，他就是舍不得让其它人的手，污了这方帕子。
他站起身，就着小二送来的一钵温水，好生洗净素帕。对养尊处优的段柯古而言，亲手揉面还是洗物，都是以往不曾做过的事。他也从不认为自己需要做，可经历过刚才挥汗如雨，他突然觉得，偶尔花点力气做点事，别有一番感动。
像这样揉洗着手绢，他便感觉心头就有股甜甜的暖意；尤其再想到她方才帮他擦脸的神态，更是忍不住低笑出声。

依他身分地位，在京上，瞧过的姑娘还会少了？可就找不出另一人，能够像她一样，集羞赧、果敢、聪慧于一身。瞧她外表，明明是个柔弱年轻的小姑娘，但瞧她站在灶房游刃有余、神气自信的神态，简直就像沙场上调度大军的女将军。
content_en:
Returning to the kitchen, Ruyi washed the picked eggplants and green onions and set them aside.
Seeing her starting to beat the eggs and knead the dough, Duan Kegu couldn't help but ask: "You gave me these flours, what will you do with the meatloaf tomorrow?"
"It's all ready." She pointed her chin toward the adjacent kitchen cabinet.
"Let's discuss it with you." He walked back and looked at her and asked, "I will stay in Yangzhou for a few more days, so I'll give you a hard time and help me prepare an extra meal. You can pay for the meal. What do you think?"
She thought for a while, then squinted her eyes to embarrass him. "A good idea to kill two birds with one stone."
"I knew I couldn't hide it from you." He stroked his hands and smiled.
He made this condition, firstly, because he wanted to give her more cash income, and secondly, because he might be able to wait for an opportunity to persuade her and her mother to go to Jiangzhou with him. Of course, the most important thing inside is to satisfy his appetite.
She kneaded the dough while thinking about it until it became smooth and soft. Then she raised her head and replied: "I have to ask my mother first."
"It's all up to you." He said as he took off his luxurious robe and came closer to her. "Shall I do it?"
"You know how?" She looked surprised.
"No." He answered readily. "It's just the noodles that I want to eat. How can I have the nerve to stand by and watch you sweating profusely from your work?"
She couldn't help but look at him a few more times. This man was completely different from the officials she had met and known.
"I know what you are thinking now." He rolled up his sleeves with his hands. "You must think I'm weird, right?"
He said this himself. Ruyi picked up the dough pin without hesitation and pressed it firmly on the dough. "See clearly, just use this method."
Duan Kegu took over. "How long will it take?"
"When the dough becomes flat, it needs to be folded again. It takes a total of eight times."
He was startled. "It's just a bowl of noodles, why does it take so much effort?"
She gave him a charming look. "If you don't mind that the noodles taste like wood chips, you can save half the formalities."
"Forget it." Since it was about how it tasted, he obeyed obediently.
Seeing that he was good at it, she went to wash her steamer with peace of mind.
"That's wrong!" He suddenly remembered while sweating profusely. "How did you, a rich young lady, learn such skills?"
"Who says a rich lady can't cook?" She turned the steamer upside down, wiped her hands and walked over. "I've seen my father stay in the kitchen since I was a child. After a while, I naturally knew that if I wanted to see him more and let him talk to me more, I had to find a way to learn more skills."
Seeing her eyebrows and eyes suddenly become gentle, it was really hard to show her filial piety.
"Right," he remembered. "Didn't your mother mention some recipes this afternoon..."
Before he could finish speaking, she suddenly covered his mouth. "Don't mention this again."
"What?" Looking at her charming face that suddenly came closer, he looked stunned.
Just then, Qu Mu poked her head in.
"Master Duan?" She looked at her daughter and Duan Kegu in surprise. "What? You guys?" How long did it take for these two people to become so familiar?
Ruyi quickly removed her hand, her cheeks slightly red. "I saw flour on his face, so I wiped it off for him -" she said as she walked to her mother's side and turned back to wink at Duan Kegu.
"Hey." Although he was confused, Duan Kegu still recognized her words. "Mom, haven't you rested yet?"
"I've already rested." Qu's mother looked at them interestingly. She didn't take a closer look earlier, but when they met again now, she realized that they were really talented and good-looking when they stood together, and they suited each other very well. "I suddenly heard someone talking, so I came to see what was going on. Mr. Duan, why are you still here so late?"
"He was angry at Xiaolianzhuang." Afraid that he would say something he shouldn't have said, Ruyi quickly explained: "I wasted time and couldn't eat good food, so I came here to try my luck."
"Oh, you have to treat her well." Qu's mother turned to look at her daughter and scolded her. "How could youLet guests cook and make things since they were children! "
How could Duan Kegu just sit back and watch Ruyi being blamed, so he quickly helped. “I was the one who forced Miss Ruyi to teach me. Also, if I don’t do it myself, I don’t know how hard it usually is for the aunt and girl Ruyi. "
"Since you want to try it yourself, I have nothing to say. Then I'll go back to the room first, and you two can rest early after your work. "Qu's mother said the last sentence while looking at her daughter.
Ruyi nodded, her mother wanted her to be careful about the gossip of people nearby; after all, she was still a daughter who had not left the court.
After Qu's mother entered the room, Duan Kegu lowered his voice and asked, "Why didn't you allow me to mention that matter just now? "
"Lu Ming. "She no longer evaded. Anyway, he already knew the things that most people don't know. "He kept forcing us to give him the recipe. We were trying to trick him. My father didn't explain it, but he didn't believe it. "
"Precious? "
She poked her head at the dough on the table, then looked up. "It was passed down secretly from my grandfather's generation, what do you think? "
It turned out to be a family heirloom, no wonder it was kept so secret. “I know, I won’t mention it again in the future. "
Seeing that he readily agreed, Ruyi couldn't help but raise her head and look at him for a while. “You…are special. "
He jokingly asked: "Because I'm willing to do it? "
This is just one of them. Ruyi turned around and started cutting the eggplant. The freshly picked and washed eggplants were round and plump, and their purple and shiny surface could still reflect her beautiful profile.
"You have no official airs, and you don't seem to have any ambitions. "
Most people heard that they hid precious recipes that were not meant to be shared with others. Who wouldn't covet them and want to get a closer look at them? But he just smiled and accepted her statement.
"You're wrong about that. He forgot that his hands were full of flour and wiped his forehead with his hands. "That's why I don't ask, because my target is you. As long as I can turn you back, what do I want to eat?" "
He smiled brightly, not realizing how funny his face turned pale. Ruyi couldn't help laughing.
"What's wrong? There's something on my face..." He foolishly touched his face with his hand, and only after taking a quick look did he realize what was going on. "Ouch! "
"I'll do it! "Can't bear to see him getting dirtier and dirtier as he wipes, Ruyi takes out a handkerchief from her arms and asks him to tilt his face slightly downward so that she can help.
He looked closely at her unpainted eyebrows, flicking the handkerchief, and could vaguely smell an elegant fragrance. At that moment, he finally understood that the beauties praised by Shuo Ren in the Book of Songs were not all based on imagination.
Because there is such a beautiful woman in front of him.
He held her hand and whispered: "The hands are like catkins, the skin is like gelatin, the collar is like a mosquito, the teeth are like gourd rhinoceros, the little head and the eyebrows are beautiful, the clever smile welcomes you, and the beautiful eyes look forward to you." "
Ruyi was familiar with the scriptures, so why didn't she understand that he was using the poem to praise her beauty. She blushed and quickly put the handkerchief into his hand. "You wipe it yourself, and I'll boil some water to prepare it. "
Looking at her pretending to be busy, he blankly took the handkerchief closer and wiped it. When he smelled the faint fragrance on it, he couldn't help but feel a strange commotion in his heart.
After dinner, Duan Kegu walked back to the "Ruweng Lai" Inn where he stayed alone. At this time, his mouth was still full of the aroma of purple eggplant and ground sesame oil. He had never tasted anything delicious in Beijing, but he didn't know that a plate of vegetarian braised noodles mixed with eggplant and green onions could be so fragrant and delicious.
And this handkerchief - in the moonlight coming in from the window, he looked over and over again at the handkerchief that had been stained by him. Perhaps out of shyness, Ruyi threw the handkerchief to him and didn't mention it again, and he took the opportunity to bring it back.
A corner of the handkerchief was embroidered with a piece of Cui Ruyi. Looking at the embroidery work, one could tell that she had brought this silk from "Xiaolian Village". It was of great significance. He should have had someone wash it before sending it back. But for some reason, he just couldn't bear to let other people's hands soil the square veil.
He stood up and took a bowl of warm water brought by the waiter to wash his handkerchief clean. For the pampered Duan Kegu, kneading the dough with his own handsEven washing things was something I had never done before. He never thought that he needed to do it, but after experiencing the profuse sweating just now, he suddenly felt that it would be very touching to spend some effort to do something occasionally.
Rubbing the handkerchief like this, he felt a sweet warmth in his heart; especially when he thought of the way she wiped his face just now, he couldn't help laughing.
Given his status, how many girls would he have seen in Beijing? But there is no other person who can combine shyness, courage, and intelligence like her. Looking at her appearance, she is obviously a weak and young girl, but looking at her confident and confident manner while standing in the kitchen, she is just like a female general who is dispatching an army on the battlefield.
